name: code_query
description: Look things up fast, no task needed: where is X, who calls it, what's in this file. mode: outline|symbols|body|map|search|impact|references|callers|callees|tests|validate|capabilities. Read-only.

mode.description: map=compact paged overview (+dir drill); body=read file/symbol content without a task; search=code_search intent search; tests=find_tests candidates; validate=sandbox_validate content; capabilities=list; capability=describe by name.

file.description: Required for outline/callers/callees/impact/tests/validate; optional with symbol for references.

symbol.description: Required for references; optional with file for callers/callees/impact.

query.description: Required for symbols (substring); capabilities: optional name/summary filter.

name.description: capability mode: exact original tool name.

category.description: capabilities mode: filter by category (e.g. query/audit/maintain).

kind.description: references only: filter by kind (call,import,use,assign,extends,implements; comma-separated).

page_size.description: map only: entries per page (default 12; packing hint).

page.description: map only: page number (default 1; pass next_page).

dir.description: map only: subdir inside workspace_dir (escapes rejected).

budget_hint.description: body only: max chars (default 1200; 0 = full, hard-capped).

new_content.description: validate only: candidate full content to check (no write).

options.description: Advanced per-mode passthrough to the original tool (e.g. callers: max_callers; impact: symbols/change_type; body: locators/context_lines). Protected keys rejected; full schema via mode=capability.
